##### SPECIFICATIONS

• GEFORCE RTX 3050 6GB 
• 2304 CUDA Cores 
• 6GB GDDR6 memory 
• 96-bit memory bus 
• Engine boost clock: 1470 MHz 
• Memory clock: 14.0 Gbps 
• PCI Express 4.0 x8 

##### SOFTWARE COMPATIBILITY

• Game Ready and NVIDIA Studio Drivers 
• PCI Express ® Gen 4 
• Microsoft DirectX ® 12 Ultimate 
• Vulkan API 
• OpenGL 4.6 
• Windows 11 / Windows 10 64-bit (v1809 November 2018 or later) 

##### CONNECTIONS

• 1 x DisplayPort 1.4a 
• 1 x HDMI ® Connector (Supports 4K 120Hz HDR, 8K 60Hz HDR, and Variable Refresh Rate as specified in the HDMI 2.1 Specification) 
• HDCP 2.3 support 
• Up to 2 displays simultaneously 

##### POWER REQUIREMENTS

• 450-watt power supply recommended 
• 70-watt max power consumption 
• PCIe Bus Powered 

SKU: ZT-A30510L-10L | EAN: 4895173628795 | UPC: 810012084642

Get Amplified with the ZOTAC GAMING GeForce RTX™ 30 Series based on the NVIDIA Ampere architecture. Built with enhanced RT Cores and Tensor Cores, streaming multiprocessors, and high-speed GDDR6 memory, the ZOTAC GAMING GeForce RTX 3050 6GB GDDR6 LP gives rise to amplified gaming while having a tiny footprint.

##### INSIDE THE BOX

• ZOTAC GAMING GeForce RTX 3050 6GB GDDR6 LP 
• User Manual 
• Low Profile Bracket
